Profitability.description: Effectiveness of addendum rates, diversification through additional services, and clarity of scopes to mitigate scope creep and optimize revenue share opportunities.

criteria.name: Scope Creep Prevention
criteria.description: Law changes to prevent scope creep; clear boundaries on what is included vs. additional
criteria.ideal: Contract clearly defines base services and lists additional services with separate fees. Language addresses legislative changes that could expand scope.

criteria.name: RFP Limits
criteria.description: Limit RFPs to certain number per year or over $5K threshold
criteria.ideal: Board may request up to three written estimates for expenditures over $5,000. Additional RFPs charged separately.

criteria.name: Bank Account Limits
criteria.description: Limit bank accounts included in base fee
criteria.ideal: Base fee covers a defined number of bank accounts. Additional accounts incur extra fees per Exhibit A.

criteria.name: Onboarding/Offboarding Fees
criteria.description: Onboarding and offboarding procedures and associated fees
criteria.ideal: Community onboarding and offboarding processes clearly defined with associated fees in Exhibit A.

criteria.name: Annual Fee Increase
criteria.description: Language for annual management fee increases
criteria.ideal: Management fee shall increase at a minimum rate of 5% on subsequent terms, tied to budget approval cycle.

criteria.name: Additional Service Revenue
criteria.description: Ability to earn revenue from additional services beyond base management
criteria.ideal: Manager permitted to render insurance, real estate services, and other affiliated services to individual owners.

Empowerment.description: How well the agreement supports expectation-setting, clearly defined services, and manager enablement in carrying out responsibilities.

criteria.name: Third-Party Vendor Outsourcing
criteria.description: Ability to use 3rd party vendors for RFPs, insurance verification, collections
criteria.ideal: Independent third parties may be used for proposals, vendor qualification/insurance verification, and collections at association expense.

criteria.name: Meeting Parameters
criteria.description: Clear limits on meeting length, frequency, days, and minutes responsibility
criteria.ideal: Specific number of meetings included in agreement. Additional meetings charged per Exhibit A. Board responsible for recording minutes.

criteria.name: Financial Statement Expectations
criteria.description: Set day-of-month threshold for financial statements; no special reports unless paying
criteria.ideal: Financial statements furnished within a set number of days after month-end. No special reports without additional compensation.

criteria.name: Spending Authority
criteria.description: Expense limit (e.g., $2,500) for manager spending authority
criteria.ideal: Manager has authority to spend up to $2,500 without prior Board approval for routine maintenance and emergencies.

criteria.name: Electronic Payment Capability
criteria.description: Can pay bills electronically or e-pay
criteria.ideal: Manager authorized to effect automatic payments for taxes, insurance, compensation, payroll, utilities, and emergencies.

criteria.name: Manager-Owner Relationship
criteria.description: Language letting manager work directly with owner if maintaining property
criteria.ideal: Manager has no obligation to individual owners but may communicate directly regarding maintenance of individually-owned property when applicable.

criteria.name: No Dispute Mediation
criteria.description: No responsibility to mediate owner-to-owner or tenant disputes
criteria.ideal: Manager has no responsibility to mediate differences between owners, tenants, or between owners and the Board.

criteria.name: Single Point of Contact
criteria.description: Board appoints single point of contact for manager
criteria.ideal: Board shall appoint a single point of contact for management to ensure efficient communication.

Risk Transference.description: Provisions for engagement with professional third parties, adequacy of indemnity clauses, and protection from liability.

criteria.name: Common Area Liability
criteria.description: Not liable for identifying risks or exposure in common areas
criteria.ideal: Manager performs compliance inspections but is not liable for identifying all risks or exposure in common areas.

criteria.name: Records Liability
criteria.description: Not liable for knowing when a house sold unless notified in writing
criteria.ideal: Manager maintains records of ownership provided changes are communicated in writing. Not liable for unreported changes.

criteria.name: Collections - Not a Debt Collector
criteria.description: Manager is not a debt collector; uses third-party collection services
criteria.ideal: Manager informs association legal counsel or third-party collection service for delinquent accounts. Manager is not a debt collector.

criteria.name: Budget/Reserve Funding
criteria.description: Reserve funding adequacy is Board responsibility
criteria.ideal: Manager indemnified against losses relating to Board's decision to fund reserve levels. Board responsible for adequate reserve funding.

criteria.name: No FDIC Guarantee Language
criteria.description: Do not state FDIC insured in bank account language
criteria.ideal: Bank account language does not guarantee FDIC insurance coverage. Manager is not a financial advisor.

criteria.name: Earning Credit Disclosure
criteria.description: Disclosure about earning credits on association accounts
criteria.ideal: Clear disclosure about any earning credits or interest earned on association funds held by manager.

criteria.name: Security Disclaimer
criteria.description: Security obligation and responsibility disclosure
criteria.ideal: Obligation to provide security is solely the Board's responsibility. Manager makes no representations regarding security adequacy.

criteria.name: Insurance Coverage
criteria.description: All types, amounts, and funds transfer insurance specified
criteria.ideal: Association carries general liability, property coverage, D&O, fidelity bond, and workers comp. Manager carries fidelity bond and E&O coverage.

criteria.name: Indemnification
criteria.description: Ability to have all costs covered including management fee and choice of counsel
criteria.ideal: Association defends and indemnifies Manager from all claims arising from association operations. Manager indemnifies association for willful misconduct only.

criteria.name: Liability Cap
criteria.description: Manager only liable for willful misconduct; limits liability to 6 months fees
criteria.ideal: Manager liability limited to willful misconduct or gross negligence, capped at 6 months of management fees.

Board Responsibilities.description: Clarity of Board member roles, conduct expectations, and alignment with the manager relationship.

criteria.name: Lawful Acts
criteria.description: Board members comply with governing documents and state law
criteria.ideal: All Board members' actions will comply with governing documents and state law.

criteria.name: Standards of Conduct
criteria.description: Directors conduct above reproach, avoid appearance of impropriety
criteria.ideal: Directors' conduct should be above reproach and avoid the appearance of impropriety.

criteria.name: Mutual Respect
criteria.description: Directors and management address each other with respect
criteria.ideal: Directors and management address each other, owners, staff, and vendors with respect even in disagreement.

criteria.name: Roberts Rules of Order
criteria.description: Meetings conducted per Roberts Rules
criteria.ideal: Directors conduct all meetings in accordance with Roberts Rules of Order.

criteria.name: Confidentiality
criteria.description: Directors maintain confidentiality on sensitive association information
criteria.ideal: Directors agree to maintain confidentiality on all sensitive association information including assessments and legal advice.

criteria.name: Board Training
criteria.description: Annual training on responsibilities and applicable laws
criteria.ideal: Board attends annual training on responsibilities, applicable state laws, and leadership.

criteria.name: Meeting Attendance
criteria.description: Board agrees to attend scheduled meetings
criteria.ideal: Board agrees to attend scheduled meetings unless proper notice of absence is provided.

criteria.name: Adequate Reserve Funding
criteria.description: Set assessments to adequately fund reserves
criteria.ideal: Board sets assessments to adequately fund reserves and maintain community to established standards.

criteria.name: Manager Right to Terminate for Board Misconduct
criteria.description: Manager can terminate or assess charges if Board members are abusive or non-compliant
criteria.ideal: Manager reserves the right to terminate or assess charges if association members or Board are abusive, threatening, or non-compliant.

Maximize Business Value.description: Agreement's ability to support transferability of rights and obligations to increase company's long-term business value.

criteria.name: Termination Provisions
criteria.description: Termination for cause or longer term notice period
criteria.ideal: Agreement may be terminated after initial term with cause by providing 60 days notice. Clear definition of cause.

criteria.name: Term Length
criteria.description: Term for more than 1 year
criteria.ideal: Initial term of 2+ years with automatic renewal provisions.

criteria.name: Electronic Fee Payment
criteria.description: Language letting manager pay their fee electronically
criteria.ideal: Manager's monthly compensation included in automatic payment authority.

criteria.name: Non-Compete Clause
criteria.description: Non-compete/non-interference provision and language
criteria.ideal: Association agrees not to hire or solicit manager's employees for 36 months after termination. Non-interference with manager's business.

criteria.name: Assignment of Rights
criteria.description: Manager can assign rights and obligations (supports business sale)
criteria.ideal: Manager may assign rights and obligations under this agreement. Upon assignment and notice, association looks solely to assignee (novation).

criteria.name: Representations Survive Termination
criteria.description: Warranties and representations survive agreement termination
criteria.ideal: All representations and warranties survive termination. Provisions that by nature should survive termination will survive.
